invariants.rationale: The method returns a new HoodieWriteMetadata object, so result should not be null at method exit.
The parameter preppedRecords must be non-null since it is used as an argument to the executor.
instantTime is an input to the executor and is expected to be non-null.
The result contains a list of WriteStatus objects, which must be non-null if result is non-null.
The number of write statuses in result cannot exceed the number of prepped records processed.
